name: The birch canoe slid on the smooth planks.
trans: 桦木独木舟在光滑的木板上滑行。

name: Glue the sheet to the dark blue background.
trans: 把这张纸粘到深蓝色的背景上。

name: It's easy to tell the depth of a well.
trans: 很容易判断一口井的深度。

name: These days a chicken leg is a rare dish.
trans: 如今鸡腿是一道稀罕的菜。

name: Rice is often served in round bowls.
trans: 米饭常常盛在圆碗里。

name: The juice of lemons makes fine punch.
trans: 柠檬汁可以调出美味的潘趣酒。

name: The box was thrown beside the parked truck.
trans: 那个箱子被扔在停着的卡车旁边。

name: The hogs were fed chopped corn and garbage.
trans: 猪被喂食切碎的玉米和泔水。

name: Four hours of steady work faced us.
trans: 我们面临着四个小时的持续工作。

name: A large size in stockings is hard to sell.
trans: 大号的长袜很难卖出去。

name: The boy was there when the sun rose.
trans: 太阳升起时那个男孩就在那儿。

name: A rod is used to catch pink salmon.
trans: 用一根鱼竿来捕捉粉红色的鲑鱼。

name: The source of the huge river is the clear spring.
trans: 这条大河的源头是一泓清泉。

name: Kick the ball straight and follow through.
trans: 把球直直地踢出去，并做好随球动作。

name: Help the woman get back to her feet.
trans: 帮那个女人重新站起来。

name: A pot of tea helps to pass the evening.
trans: 一壶茶有助于消磨夜晚时光。

name: Smoky fires lack flame and heat.
trans: 冒烟的火缺少火焰和热量。

name: The soft cushion broke the man's fall.
trans: 柔软的坐垫缓冲了那人跌落的冲击。

name: The salt breeze came across from the sea.
trans: 咸咸的海风从海上吹来。

name: The girl at the booth sold fifty bonds.
trans: 摊位上的女孩卖出了五十份债券。

name: The small pup gnawed a hole in the sock.
trans: 小狗崽在袜子上啃出一个洞。

name: The fish twisted and turned on the bent hook.
trans: 鱼在弯曲的鱼钩上扭动翻腾。

name: Press the pants and sew a button on the vest.
trans: 熨一下裤子，再在背心上缝个扣子。

name: The swan dive was far short of perfect.
trans: 那个天鹅式跳水远算不上完美。

name: The beauty of the view stunned the young boy.
trans: 美景让那个小男孩惊呆了。

name: Two blue fish swam in the tank.
trans: 两条蓝色的鱼在水箱里游动。

name: Her purse was full of useless trash.
trans: 她的钱包里装满了没用的杂物。

name: The colt reared and threw the tall rider.
trans: 小马直立起来，把高个子骑手甩了下去。

name: It snowed, rained, and hailed the same morning.
trans: 那天早上又下雪又下雨还下冰雹。

name: Read verse out loud for pleasure.
trans: 大声朗读诗句以自娱。

name: Hoist the load to your left shoulder.
trans: 把货物扛到你的左肩上。

name: Take the winding path to reach the lake.
trans: 沿着蜿蜒的小路走到湖边。

name: Note closely the size of the gas tank.
trans: 仔细留意油箱的大小。

name: Wipe the grease off his dirty face.
trans: 把他脏脸上的油污擦掉。

name: Mend the coat before you go out.
trans: 出门前把外套补好。

name: The wrist was badly strained and hung limp.
trans: 手腕严重扭伤，无力地垂着。

name: The stray cat gave birth to kittens.
trans: 那只流浪猫生了小猫。

name: The young girl gave no clear response.
trans: 那个小女孩没有给出明确的回应。

name: The meal was cooked before the bell rang.
trans: 铃响之前饭就做好了。

name: What joy there is in living.
trans: 活着是多么快乐啊。

name: A king ruled the state in the early days.
trans: 早年间一位国王统治着这个邦国。

name: The ship was torn apart on the sharp reef.
trans: 那艘船在尖锐的暗礁上撞得四分五裂。

name: Sickness kept him home the third week.
trans: 疾病使他第三周只能待在家里。

name: The wide road shimmered in the hot sun.
trans: 宽阔的道路在炎炎烈日下闪着微光。

name: The lazy cow lay in the cool grass.
trans: 懒洋洋的奶牛躺在凉爽的草地上。

name: Lift the square stone over the fence.
trans: 把那块方石举过栅栏。

name: The rope will bind the seven books at once.
trans: 这根绳子能把七本书一次捆好。

name: Hop over the fence and plunge in.
trans: 跳过栅栏一头扎进去。

name: The friendly gang left the drug store.
trans: 那群友善的人离开了药店。

name: Mesh wire keeps chicks inside.
trans: 网状铁丝把小鸡关在里面。

name: The frosty air passed through the coat.
trans: 寒冷的空气穿透了外套。

name: The crooked maze failed to fool the mouse.
trans: 弯弯曲曲的迷宫没能把老鼠难住。

name: Adding fast leads to wrong sums.
trans: 算得太快会导致算错总数。

name: The show was a flop from the very start.
trans: 这场演出从一开始就是个失败。

name: A saw is a tool used for making boards.
trans: 锯子是用来制作木板的工具。

name: The wagon moved on well oiled wheels.
trans: 马车在润滑良好的轮子上前行。

name: March the soldiers past the next hill.
trans: 让士兵们行军越过下一座山。

name: A cup of sugar makes sweet fudge.
trans: 一杯糖能做出香甜的软糖。

name: Place a rosebush near the porch steps.
trans: 在门廊台阶附近种一丛玫瑰。

name: Both lost their lives in the raging storm.
trans: 两人都在肆虐的风暴中丧生。

name: We talked of the side show in the circus.
trans: 我们谈论着马戏团里的余兴表演。

name: Use a pencil to write the first draft.
trans: 用铅笔写第一稿。

name: He ran half way to the hardware store.
trans: 他跑了一半的路去五金店。

name: The clock struck to mark the third period.
trans: 时钟敲响，标志着第三节课的到来。

name: A small creek cut across the field.
trans: 一条小溪穿过田野。

name: Cars and busses stalled in snow drifts.
trans: 汽车和公共汽车都陷在积雪里动不了。

name: The set of china hit the floor with a crash.
trans: 那套瓷器哐当一声摔在地上。

name: This is a grand season for hikes on the road.
trans: 这是徒步旅行的绝佳季节。

name: The dune rose from the edge of the water.
trans: 沙丘从水边隆起。

name: Those words were the cue for the actor to leave.
trans: 那些台词是那位演员退场的提示。

name: A yacht slid around the point into the bay.
trans: 一艘游艇绕过海角滑入海湾。

name: The two met while playing on the sand.
trans: 两人在沙滩上玩耍时相遇了。

name: The ink stain dried on the finished page.
trans: 墨渍在写完的那页纸上干了。

name: The walled town was seized without a fight.
trans: 那座有城墙的小镇不战而被攻占。

name: The lease ran out in sixteen weeks.
trans: 租约十六周后到期。

name: A tame squirrel makes a nice pet.
trans: 驯养的松鼠是很好的宠物。

name: The horn of the car woke the sleeping cop.
trans: 汽车喇叭声吵醒了打瞌睡的警察。

name: The heart beat strongly and with firm strokes.
trans: 心脏强劲而有力地跳动着。

name: The pearl was worn in a thin silver ring.
trans: 那颗珍珠镶嵌在一枚细银戒指上。

name: The fruit peel was cut in thick slices.
trans: 果皮被切成厚片。

name: The Navy attacked the big task force.
trans: 海军袭击了那支庞大的特遣部队。

name: See the cat glaring at the scared mouse.
trans: 看那只猫瞪着受惊的老鼠。

name: There are more than two factors here.
trans: 这里的因素不止两个。

name: The hat brim was wide and too droopy.
trans: 帽檐又宽又耷拉。

name: The lawyer tried to lose his case.
trans: 那名律师竟想输掉这场官司。

name: The grass curled around the fence post.
trans: 青草缠绕在篱笆柱周围。

name: Cut the pie into large parts.
trans: 把馅饼切成大块。

name: Men strive but seldom get rich.
trans: 人们努力奋斗，却很少能致富。

name: Always close the barn door tight.
trans: 一定要把谷仓门关紧。

name: He lay prone and hardly moved a limb.
trans: 他趴着躺下，几乎一动不动。

name: The slush lay deep along the street.
trans: 街道上积着厚厚的雪泥。

name: A wisp of cloud hung in the blue air.
trans: 一缕云彩悬在蔚蓝的天空中。

name: A pound of sugar costs more than eggs.
trans: 一磅糖比鸡蛋还贵。

name: The fin was sharp and cut the clear water.
trans: 鱼鳍锋利，划破清澈的水面。

name: The play seems dull and quite stupid.
trans: 这出戏似乎枯燥又相当愚蠢。

name: Bail the boat to stop it from sinking.
trans: 把船里的水舀出去，以免下沉。

name: The term ended in late June that year.
trans: 那一年的学期在六月底结束。

name: A tusk is used to make costly gifts.
trans: 象牙被用来制作昂贵的礼物。

name: Ten pins were set in order.
trans: 十个瓶柱被摆放整齐。

name: The bill was paid every third week.
trans: 账单每三周付一次。

name: Oak is strong and also gives shade.
trans: 橡树坚固，还能遮荫。

name: Cats and dogs each hate the other.
trans: 猫和狗彼此都讨厌对方。

name: The pipe began to rust while new.
trans: 那根管子还是新的就开始生锈了。

name: Open the crate but don't break the glass.
trans: 打开板条箱，但别打碎玻璃。

name: Add the sum to the product of these three.
trans: 把这三者的乘积加到总和里。

name: Thieves who rob friends deserve jail.
trans: 偷盗朋友的贼应该坐牢。

name: The ripe taste of cheese improves with age.
trans: 奶酪熟成的味道随时间而愈发醇美。

name: Act on these orders with great speed.
trans: 火速执行这些命令。

name: The hog crawled under the high fence.
trans: 猪从高高的栅栏底下钻了过去。

name: Move the vat over the hot fire.
trans: 把大桶挪到旺火上。

name: The bark of the pine tree was shiny and dark.
trans: 松树的树皮油亮而深色。

name: Leaves turn brown and yellow in the fall.
trans: 秋天树叶会变成棕色和黄色。

name: The pennant waved when the wind blew.
trans: 风一吹，三角旗就飘动起来。

name: Split the log with a quick, sharp blow.
trans: 用一记又快又狠的劈砍把木头劈开。

name: Burn peat after the logs give out.
trans: 木柴烧完后就烧泥炭。

name: He ordered peach pie with ice cream.
trans: 他点了配冰淇淋的桃子派。

name: Weave the carpet on the right hand side.
trans: 在右手边织地毯。

name: Hemp is a weed found in parts of the tropics.
trans: 大麻是热带部分地区常见的一种野草。

name: A lame back kept his score low.
trans: 腰伤让他的得分一直不高。

name: We find joy in the simplest things.
trans: 我们在最简单的事物中找到快乐。

name: Type out three lists of orders.
trans: 打出三份订单清单。

name: The harder he tried the less he got done.
trans: 他越努力，完成的反而越少。

name: The boss ran the show with a watchful eye.
trans: 老板睁大眼睛主持整个场面。

name: The cup cracked and spilled its contents.
trans: 杯子裂开，里面的东西洒了出来。

name: Paste can cleanse the most dirty brass.
trans: 膏状清洁剂能清洁最脏的黄铜器物。

name: The slang word for raw whiskey is booze.
trans: 生威士忌的俚语叫法是booze。

name: It caught its hind paw in a rusty trap.
trans: 它的后爪被夹在一个生锈的陷阱里。

name: The wharf could be seen at the farther shore.
trans: 在对岸可以看见那个码头。

name: Feel the heat of the weak dying flame.
trans: 感受一下那微弱将熄的火焰的余热。

name: The tiny girl took off her hat.
trans: 那个小女孩摘下了她的帽子。

name: A cramp is no small danger on a swim.
trans: 游泳时抽筋可不是小危险。

name: He said the same phrase thirty times.
trans: 他把同一句话说了三十遍。

name: Pluck the bright rose without leaves.
trans: 摘下那朵没有叶子的鲜艳玫瑰。

name: Two plus seven is less than ten.
trans: 二加七小于十。

name: The glow deepened in the eyes of the sweet girl.
trans: 那个可爱女孩眼中的光芒愈发深邃。

name: Bring your problems to the wise chief.
trans: 把你的难题带给那位睿智的首领。

name: Write a fond note to the friend you cherish.
trans: 给你珍视的朋友写一张深情的便条。

name: Clothes and lodging are free to new men.
trans: 新来的人可以免费获得衣物和住宿。

name: We frown when events take a bad turn.
trans: 事情变糟时我们会皱眉。

name: Port is a strong wine with a smoky taste.
trans: 波特酒是一种带有烟熏味的烈性葡萄酒。

name: The young kid jumped the rusty gate.
trans: 那个小孩跳过了那扇生锈的大门。

name: Guess the results from the first scores.
trans: 从最初的比分猜测结果。

name: A salt pickle tastes fine with ham.
trans: 咸腌菜配火腿味道不错。

name: The just claim got the right verdict.
trans: 那个正当的诉求得到了公正的裁决。

name: These thistles bend in a high wind.
trans: 这些蓟草在大风中弯下腰。

name: Pure bred poodles have curls.
trans: 纯种贵宾犬的毛是卷曲的。

name: The tree top waved in a graceful way.
trans: 树梢优雅地摇曳着。

name: The spot on the blotter was made by green ink.
trans: 吸墨纸上的那块污渍是绿色墨水弄的。

name: Mud was spattered on the front of his white shirt.
trans: 泥点溅到了他白衬衫的前襟上。

name: The cigar burned a hole in the desk top.
trans: 雪茄在桌面上烫出了一个洞。

name: The empty flask stood on the tin tray.
trans: 空烧瓶立在锡盘上。

name: A speedy man can beat this track mark.
trans: 一个速度快的人能打破这个赛道纪录。

name: He broke a new shoelace that day.
trans: 那天他弄断了一根新鞋带。

name: The coffee stand is too high for the couch.
trans: 咖啡桌相对沙发来说太高了。

name: The urge to write short stories is rare.
trans: 想写短篇小说的冲动很少见。

name: The pencils have all been used.
trans: 铅笔都已经用完了。

name: The pirates seized the crew of the lost ship.
trans: 海盗抓住了那艘失踪船只的船员。

name: We tried to replace the coin but failed.
trans: 我们试图找回那枚硬币，但失败了。

name: She sewed the torn coat quite neatly.
trans: 她把破损的外套缝补得很整齐。

name: The sofa cushion is red and of light weight.
trans: 沙发坐垫是红色的，很轻。

name: The jacket hung on the back of the wide chair.
trans: 外套挂在那把宽大椅子的靠背上。

name: At that high level the air is pure.
trans: 在那样的高处，空气很纯净。

name: Drop the two when you add the figures.
trans: 把这两个数字加起来时要把那个二忽略。

name: A filing case is now hard to buy.
trans: 现在很难买到文件柜。

name: An abrupt start does not win the prize.
trans: 仓促的开局赢不了奖。

name: Wood is best for making toys and blocks.
trans: 木头最适合用来做玩具和积木。

name: The office paint was a dull, sad tan.
trans: 办公室的漆是一种黯淡忧郁的棕褐色。

name: He knew the skill of the great young actress.
trans: 他深知那位杰出年轻女演员的演技。

name: A rag will soak up spilled water.
trans: 一块抹布能吸干洒出来的水。

name: A shower of dirt fell from the hot pipes.
trans: 一阵尘土从灼热的管道上落下。

name: Steam hissed from the broken valve.
trans: 蒸汽从损坏的阀门里嘶嘶地冒出来。

name: The child almost hurt the small dog.
trans: 那孩子差点伤到那只小狗。

name: There was a sound of dry leaves outside.
trans: 外面传来干枯树叶的声响。

name: The sky that morning was clear and bright blue.
trans: 那天早晨的天空晴朗湛蓝。

name: Torn scraps littered the stone floor.
trans: 撕碎的纸片散落在石地板上。

name: Sunday is the best part of the week.
trans: 星期天是一周中最好的时光。

name: The doctor cured him with these pills.
trans: 医生用这些药丸治好了他。

name: The new girl was fired today at noon.
trans: 那个新来的女孩今天中午被解雇了。

name: They felt gay when the ship arrived in port.
trans: 船进港时他们感到很欢快。

name: Add the store's account to the last cent.
trans: 把商店的账目精确加到最后一分钱。

name: Acid burns holes in wool cloth.
trans: 酸会在羊毛布上烧出洞来。

name: Fairy tales should be fun to write.
trans: 写童话故事应该是件有趣的事。

name: Eight miles of woodland burned to waste.
trans: 八英里的林地被烧成废墟。

name: The third act was dull and tired the players.
trans: 第三幕枯燥乏味，让演员们疲惫不堪。

name: A young child should not suffer fright.
trans: 幼童不应该受到惊吓。

name: Add the column and put the sum here.
trans: 把这一列相加，把总数写在这里。

name: We admire and love a good cook.
trans: 我们敬佩并喜爱一位好厨师。

name: There the flood mark is ten inches.
trans: 那里的洪水痕迹有十英寸高。

name: He carved a head from the round block of marble.
trans: 他从那块圆形大理石上雕出一个头像。

name: She has a smart way of wearing clothes.
trans: 她穿衣服很有品味。

name: The fruit of a fig tree is apple-shaped.
trans: 无花果树的果实是苹果形状的。

name: Corn cobs can be used to kindle a fire.
trans: 玉米芯可以用来生火。

name: Where were they when the noise started.
trans: 噪音刚响起时他们在哪儿。

name: The paper box is full of thumb tacks.
trans: 那个纸盒里装满了图钉。

name: Sell your gift to a buyer at a good gain.
trans: 把你的礼物卖给买家，赚一笔好收益。

name: The tongs lay beside the ice pail.
trans: 钳子放在冰桶旁边。

name: The petals fall with the next puff of wind.
trans: 下一阵风吹来，花瓣就会飘落。

name: Bring your best compass to the third class.
trans: 把你最好的圆规带到第三节课上。

name: They could laugh although they were sad.
trans: 尽管他们很难过，却还是能笑出来。

name: Farmers came in to thresh the oat crop.
trans: 农民们进来给燕麦脱粒。

name: The brown house was on fire to the attic.
trans: 那栋棕色的房子从阁楼烧了起来。

name: The lure is used to catch trout and flounder.
trans: 这个诱饵是用来钓鳟鱼和比目鱼的。

name: Float the soap on top of the bath water.
trans: 让肥皂漂浮在洗澡水的水面上。

name: A blue crane is a tall wading bird.
trans: 蓝鹤是一种高大的涉禽。

name: A fresh start will work such wonders.
trans: 重新开始会创造这样的奇迹。

name: The club rented the rink for the fifth night.
trans: 俱乐部租下了溜冰场，用于第五个晚上。

name: After the dance, they went straight home.
trans: 舞会结束后，他们直接回家了。

name: The hostess taught the new maid to serve.
trans: 女主人教新来的女仆如何服侍。

name: He wrote his last novel there at the inn.
trans: 他在那家旅店里写完了他的最后一部小说。

name: Even the worst will beat his low score.
trans: 即使是最差的人也能超过他的低分。

name: The cement had dried when he moved it.
trans: 他移动它的时候水泥已经干了。

name: The loss of the second ship was hard to take.
trans: 第二艘船的损失让人难以接受。

name: The fly made its way along the wall.
trans: 那只苍蝇沿着墙壁爬行。

name: Do that with a wooden stick.
trans: 用一根木棍来做这件事。

name: Live wires should be kept covered.
trans: 带电的电线应该保持覆盖。

name: The large house had hot water taps.
trans: 那栋大房子装有热水龙头。

name: It is hard to erase blue or red ink.
trans: 蓝色或红色的墨水很难擦掉。

name: Write at once or you may forget it.
trans: 立刻写下来，否则你可能会忘记。

name: The doorknob was made of bright clean brass.
trans: 门把手是用锃亮干净的黄铜做的。

name: The wreck occurred by the bank on Main Street.
trans: 那起事故发生在主街的银行旁边。

name: A pencil with black lead writes best.
trans: 黑铅笔芯的铅笔写起字来最好。

name: Coax a young calf to drink from a bucket.
trans: 哄小牛犊从桶里喝水。

name: Schools for ladies teach charm and grace.
trans: 女子学校教授魅力与优雅。

name: The lamp shone with a steady green flame.
trans: 那盏灯闪烁着稳定的绿色火焰。

name: They took the axe and the saw to the forest.
trans: 他们带着斧头和锯子去了森林。

name: The ancient coin was quite dull and worn.
trans: 那枚古币又暗淡又磨损。

name: The shaky barn fell with a loud crash.
trans: 摇摇欲坠的谷仓轰然倒塌。

name: Jazz and swing fans like fast music.
trans: 爵士乐和摇摆乐的爱好者喜欢节奏快的音乐。

name: Rake the rubbish up and then burn it.
trans: 把垃圾耙成一堆然后烧掉。

name: Slash the gold cloth into fine ribbons.
trans: 把那块金色的布裁成细细的丝带。

name: Try to have the court decide the case.
trans: 尽量让法庭来裁决这个案子。

name: They are pushed back each time they attack.
trans: 他们每次进攻都被击退。

name: He broke his ties with groups of former friends.
trans: 他与以前的朋友圈断绝了往来。

name: They floated on the raft to sun their white backs.
trans: 他们躺在筏子上漂浮，晒晒白皙的后背。

name: The map had an X that meant nothing.
trans: 地图上有个X标记，但毫无意义。

name: Whitings are small fish caught in nets.
trans: 牙鳕是用网捕获的小鱼。

name: Some ads serve to cheat buyers.
trans: 有些广告的作用是欺骗买家。

name: Jerk the rope and the bell rings weakly.
trans: 猛拉绳子，铃铛发出微弱的响声。

name: A waxed floor makes us lose balance.
trans: 打过蜡的地板会让我们失去平衡。

name: Madam, this is the best brand of corn.
trans: 女士，这是最好的玉米品牌。

name: On the islands the sea breeze is soft and mild.
trans: 岛上的海风轻柔而温和。

name: The play began as soon as we sat down.
trans: 我们一坐下演出就开始了。

name: This will lead the world to more sound and fury.
trans: 这将把世界引向更多的喧嚣与狂躁。

name: Add salt before you fry the egg.
trans: 煎蛋之前先加盐。

name: The rush for funds reached its peak Tuesday.
trans: 资金抢购在周二达到了顶峰。

name: The birch looked stark white and lonesome.
trans: 那棵桦树看起来白得刺眼，孤零零的。

name: The box is held by a bright red snapper.
trans: 那个盒子由一个鲜红色的按扣扣住。

name: To make pure ice, you freeze water.
trans: 要做出纯净的冰，你得把水冻结。

name: The first worm gets snapped early.
trans: 第一条虫子最先被啄走。

name: Jump the fence and hurry up the bank.
trans: 跳过栅栏，快步冲上河岸。

name: Yell and clap as the curtain slides back.
trans: 大幕拉开时又喊又鼓掌。

name: They are men who walk the middle of the road.
trans: 他们是走中庸路线的人。

name: Both brothers wear the same size.
trans: 兄弟俩穿同样的尺码。

name: In some form or other we need fun.
trans: 不管以何种形式，我们都需要乐趣。

name: The prince ordered his head chopped off.
trans: 王子下令把他的头砍掉。

name: The houses are built of red clay bricks.
trans: 这些房子是用红粘土砖建造的。

name: Ducks fly north but lack a compass.
trans: 鸭子向北飞，却没有指南针。

name: Fruit flavors are used in fizz drinks.
trans: 果味被用于汽水饮料中。

name: These pills do less good than others.
trans: 这些药丸的疗效不如其他的。

name: Canned pears lack full flavor.
trans: 罐装梨的味道不够浓郁。

name: The dark pot hung in the front closet.
trans: 那口深色的锅挂在前厅的橱柜里。

name: Carry the pail to the wall and spill it there.
trans: 把水桶提到墙边，把水倒在那里。

name: The train brought our hero to the big town.
trans: 火车把我们的英雄带到了这座大城镇。

name: We are sure that one war is enough.
trans: 我们确信一场战争就够了。

name: Gray paint stretched for miles around.
trans: 灰色的油漆铺展开来，绵延数英里。

name: The rude laugh filled the empty room.
trans: 粗鲁的笑声充满了空荡荡的房间。

name: High seats are best for football fans.
trans: 高处的座位最适合足球迷。

name: Tea served from the brown jug is tasty.
trans: 用棕色水罐倒出的茶很好喝。

name: A dash of pepper spoils beef stew.
trans: 一小撮胡椒会毁了炖牛肉。

name: A zestful food is the hot-cross bun.
trans: 十字面包是一种味道浓郁的食物。

name: The horse trotted around the field at a brisk pace.
trans: 那匹马以轻快的步伐绕着场地小跑。

name: Find the twin who stole the pearl necklace.
trans: 找出偷了珍珠项链的那个双胞胎。

name: Cut the cord that binds the box tightly.
trans: 剪断紧紧捆住箱子的绳子。

name: The red tape bound the smuggled food.
trans: 红色胶带捆着走私的食物。

name: Look in the corner to find the tan shirt.
trans: 到墙角找那件棕褐色的衬衫。

name: The cold drizzle will halt the bond drive.
trans: 寒冷的细雨将使公债推销活动停止。

name: Nine men were hired to dig the ruins.
trans: 雇了九个人来挖掘那处废墟。

name: The junk yard had a mouldy smell.
trans: 废品场散发着霉味。

name: The flint sputtered and lit a pine torch.
trans: 燧石噼啪作响，点燃了一支松木火把。

name: Soak the cloth and drown the sharp odor.
trans: 把布浸湿，压住那刺鼻的气味。

name: The shelves were bare of both jam or crackers.
trans: 架子上既没有果酱也没有饼干，空空如也。

name: A joy to every child is the swan boat.
trans: 天鹅船是每个孩子的乐趣。

name: All sat frozen and watched the screen.
trans: 所有人都僵坐着盯着屏幕。

name: A cloud of dust stung his tender eyes.
trans: 一团尘土刺痛了他娇嫩的双眼。

name: To reach the end he needs much courage.
trans: 要到达终点，他需要极大的勇气。

name: Shape the clay gently into block form.
trans: 轻轻地把粘土捏成块状。

name: A ridge on a smooth surface is a bump or flaw.
trans: 光滑表面上的隆起是一个凸起或瑕疵。

name: Hedge apples may stain your hands green.
trans: 樱桃橘可能会把你的手染成绿色。

name: Quench your thirst, then eat the crackers.
trans: 先解渴，再吃饼干。

name: Tight curls get limp on rainy days.
trans: 紧密的卷发在雨天会变得软塌塌的。

name: The mute muffled the high tones of the horn.
trans: 弱音器压低了号角的高音。

name: The gold ring fits only a pierced ear.
trans: 那枚金耳环只适合打了耳洞的耳朵。

name: The old pan was covered with hard fudge.
trans: 那口旧锅上覆盖着一层硬邦邦的软糖。

name: Watch the log float in the wide river.
trans: 看那根木头在宽阔的河里漂浮。

name: The node on the stalk of wheat grew daily.
trans: 麦秆上的节每天都在生长。

name: The heap of fallen leaves was set on fire.
trans: 那堆落叶被点燃了。

name: Write fast if you want to finish early.
trans: 想要早点写完就得写快点。

name: His shirt was clean but one button was gone.
trans: 他的衬衫很干净，但少了一颗扣子。

name: The barrel of beer was a brew of malt and hops.
trans: 那桶啤酒是用麦芽和啤酒花酿造的。

name: Tin cans are absent from store shelves.
trans: 商店货架上没有罐头。

name: Slide the box into that empty space.
trans: 把箱子滑进那个空位里。

name: The plant grew large and green in the window.
trans: 那株植物在窗台上长得又大又绿。

name: The beam dropped down on the workmen's head.
trans: 那根横梁砸在了工人的头上。

name: Pink clouds floated with the breeze.
trans: 粉红色的云朵随微风飘荡。

name: She danced like a swan, tall and graceful.
trans: 她像天鹅一样翩翩起舞，高挑而优雅。

name: The tube was blown and the tire flat and useless.
trans: 内胎爆了，轮胎瘪了没用了。

name: It is late morning on the old wall clock.
trans: 老挂钟显示已是上午快晌午了。

name: Let's all join as we sing the last chorus.
trans: 让我们大家一起唱最后一段副歌。

name: The last switch cannot be turned off.
trans: 最后那个开关关不掉。

name: The fight will end in just six minutes.
trans: 这场战斗再过六分钟就会结束。

name: The store walls were lined with colored frocks.
trans: 商店的墙上挂满了各色连衣裙。

name: The peace league met to discuss their plans.
trans: 和平联盟开会讨论他们的计划。

name: The rise to fame of a person takes luck.
trans: 一个人成名靠的是运气。

name: Paper is scarce, so write with much care.
trans: 纸张紧缺，所以写字要格外小心。

name: The quick fox jumped on the sleeping cat.
trans: 敏捷的狐狸扑向那只熟睡的猫。

name: The nozzle of the fire hose was bright brass.
trans: 消防水管的喷嘴是锃亮的黄铜。

name: Screw the round cap on as tight as needed.
trans: 把圆形盖子拧到所需的紧度。

name: Time brings us many changes.
trans: 时间给我们带来许多变化。

name: The purple tie was ten years old.
trans: 那条紫色领带已经十年了。

name: Men think and plan and sometimes act.
trans: 人们思考、计划，有时也付诸行动。

name: Fill the ink jar with sticky glue.
trans: 把墨水罐装满黏胶。

name: He smoke a big pipe with strong contents.
trans: 他抽着一支大烟斗，里面装着劲很大的烟丝。

name: We need grain to keep our mules healthy.
trans: 我们需要谷物来保持骡子健康。

name: Pack the records in a neat thin case.
trans: 把唱片装进一个整洁的薄盒子里。

name: The crunch of feet in the snow was the only sound.
trans: 雪地里脚步的嘎吱声是唯一的声响。

name: The copper bowl shone in the sun's rays.
trans: 铜碗在阳光下闪闪发光。

name: Boards will warp unless kept dry.
trans: 木板不保持干燥就会翘曲。

name: The plush chair leaned against the wall.
trans: 那把绒面椅子靠在墙边。

name: Glass will clink when struck by metal.
trans: 玻璃被金属敲击时会发出叮当声。

name: Bathe and relax in the cool green grass.
trans: 在凉爽的绿草地上沐浴放松。

name: Nine rows of soldiers stood in line.
trans: 九排士兵列队站立。

name: The beach is dry and shallow at low tide.
trans: 退潮时沙滩又干又浅。

name: The idea is to sew both edges straight.
trans: 关键是把两条边都缝得笔直。

name: The kitten chased the dog down the street.
trans: 小猫沿着街道追赶那只狗。

name: Pages bound in cloth make a book.
trans: 用布装订的书页构成一本书。

name: Try to trace the fine lines of the painting.
trans: 试着描摹这幅画的细腻线条。

name: Women form less than half of the group.
trans: 女性占该群体的比例不到一半。

name: The zones merge in the central part of town.
trans: 各区域在城镇中心汇合。

name: A gem in the rough needs work to polish.
trans: 一块未经雕琢的宝石需要打磨。

name: Code is used when secrets are sent.
trans: 传递秘密信息时会使用密码。

name: Most of the news is easy for us to hear.
trans: 大部分新闻我们都很容易听懂。

name: He used the lathe to make brass objects.
trans: 他用车床制作黄铜物件。

name: The vane on top of the pole revolved in the wind.
trans: 杆顶的风向标在风中转动。

name: Mince pie is a dish served to children.
trans: 百果馅饼是给孩子们吃的一道菜。

name: The clan gathered on each dull night.
trans: 每个乏味的夜晚，家族都会聚在一起。

name: Let it burn, it gives us warmth and comfort.
trans: 让它燃烧吧，它给我们带来温暖和舒适。

name: A castle built from sand fails to endure.
trans: 用沙子建成的城堡经不起时间考验。

name: A child's wit saved the day for us.
trans: 一个孩子的机智为我们解了围。

name: Tack the strip of carpet to the worn floor.
trans: 把那条地毯用钉子固定在磨损的地板上。

name: Next Tuesday we must vote.
trans: 下周二我们必须投票。

name: Pour the stew from the pot into the plate.
trans: 把炖菜从锅里倒进盘子里。

name: Each penny shone like new.
trans: 每一枚便士都亮得像新的一样。

name: The man went to the woods to gather sticks.
trans: 那个人去树林里捡柴火。

name: The dirt piles were lines along the road.
trans: 一堆堆泥土沿着路边排成行。

name: The logs fell and tumbled into the clear stream.
trans: 原木倒下，滚落进清澈的溪流中。

name: Just hoist it up and take it away.
trans: 只需把它吊起来搬走。

name: A ripe plum is fit for a king's palate.
trans: 一颗成熟的李子配得上国王的口味。

name: Our plans right now are hazy.
trans: 我们目前的计划还很模糊。

name: Brass rings are sold by these natives.
trans: 这些当地人出售黄铜戒指。

name: It takes a good trap to capture a bear.
trans: 抓熊需要一个好陷阱。

name: Feed the white mouse some flower seeds.
trans: 喂那只白老鼠一些花的种子。

name: The thaw came early and freed the stream.
trans: 解冻来得早，溪流也随之解封。

name: He took the lead and kept it the whole distance.
trans: 他率先领跑，并一直领先到终点。

name: The key you designed will fit the lock.
trans: 你设计的钥匙能配上那把锁。

name: Plead to the council to free the poor thief.
trans: 恳求议会释放那个可怜的小偷。

name: Better hash is made of rare beef.
trans: 用嫩牛肉做的碎肉杂烩更好吃。

name: This plank was made for walking on.
trans: 这块木板是用来走的。

name: The lake sparkled in the red hot sun.
trans: 湖面在炙热的红日下闪闪发光。

name: He crawled with care along the ledge.
trans: 他小心翼翼地沿着窄崖爬行。

name: Tend the sheep while the dog wanders.
trans: 在狗四处闲逛的时候照看那些羊。

name: It takes a lot of help to finish these.
trans: 完成这些需要很多帮助。

name: Mark the spot with a sign painted red.
trans: 用一个漆成红色的标记标出那个地点。

name: Take two shares as a fair profit.
trans: 拿两份作为合理的利润。

name: The fur of cats goes by many names.
trans: 猫的毛皮有很多种叫法。

name: North winds bring colds and fevers.
trans: 北风带来感冒和发烧。

name: He asks no person to vouch for him.
trans: 他不需要任何人为他担保。

name: Go now and come here later.
trans: 现在就走，晚点再回来。

name: A sash of gold silk will trim her dress.
trans: 一条金色丝绸腰带将装点她的裙子。

name: Soap can wash most dirt away.
trans: 肥皂能洗掉大部分污垢。

name: That move means the game is over.
trans: 那一步意味着游戏结束了。

name: He wrote down a long list of items.
trans: 他写下了一长串物品清单。

name: A siege will crack the strong defense.
trans: 围攻会攻破坚固的防线。

name: Grape juice and water mix well.
trans: 葡萄汁和水混合得很好。

name: Roads are paved with sticky tar.
trans: 道路是用黏稠的沥青铺就的。

name: Fake stones shine but cost little.
trans: 假宝石很闪亮，但价格便宜。

name: The drip of the rain made a pleasant sound.
trans: 雨滴滴答的声音很悦耳。

name: Smoke poured out of every crack.
trans: 烟从每一道裂缝中涌出。

name: Serve the hot rum to the tired heroes.
trans: 给疲惫的英雄们端上热朗姆酒。

name: Much of the story makes good sense.
trans: 这个故事大部分都很合理。

name: The sun came up to light the eastern sky.
trans: 太阳升起，照亮了东方的天空。

name: Heave the line over the port side.
trans: 把绳子甩到船的左舷。

name: A lathe cuts and trims any wood.
trans: 车床能切割修整任何木材。

name: It's a dense crowd in two distinct ways.
trans: 这是一群密集的人群，有两种截然不同的方式。

name: His hip struck the knee of the next player.
trans: 他的臀部撞到了旁边球员的膝盖。

name: The stale smell of old beer lingers.
trans: 陈啤酒那股走了味的气味久久不散。

name: The desk was firm on the shaky floor.
trans: 尽管地板摇晃，那张桌子却很稳固。

name: It takes heat to bring out the odor.
trans: 需要加热才能散发出那种气味。

name: Beef is scarcer than some lamb.
trans: 牛肉比某些羊肉更稀缺。

name: Raise the sail and steer the ship northward.
trans: 升起风帆，把船驶向北方。

name: A cone costs five cents on Mondays.
trans: 星期一的甜筒只要五美分。

name: A pod is what peas always grow in.
trans: 豆荚是豌豆总是生长其中的东西。

name: Jerk the dart from the cork target.
trans: 猛地把飞镖从软木靶上拔出来。

name: No cement will hold hard wood.
trans: 没有水泥能粘住硬木。

name: We now have a new base for shipping.
trans: 我们现在有了一个新的运输基地。

name: A list of names is carved around the base.
trans: 底座周围刻着一份名单。

name: The sheep were led home by a dog.
trans: 羊群被一只狗领回了家。

name: Three for a dime, the young peddler cried.
trans: 一角钱三个，年轻的小贩叫卖道。

name: The sense of smell is better than that of touch.
trans: 嗅觉比触觉更敏锐。

name: No hardship seemed to keep him sad.
trans: 似乎没有什么困苦能让他一直难过。

name: Grace makes up for lack of beauty.
trans: 优雅弥补了美貌的不足。

name: Nudge gently but wake her now.
trans: 轻轻推一下，但现在就把她叫醒。

name: The news struck doubt into restless minds.
trans: 这个消息在不安的心中激起了疑虑。

name: Once we stood beside the shore.
trans: 我们曾经站在岸边。

name: A chink in the wall allowed a draft to blow.
trans: 墙上的一道裂缝让穿堂风吹了进来。

name: Fasten two pins on each side.
trans: 每一边都别上两个别针。

name: A cold dip restores health and zest.
trans: 一次冷水浴能恢复健康和活力。

name: He takes the oath of office each March.
trans: 他每年三月都要宣誓就职。

name: The sand drifts over the sill of the old house.
trans: 沙子飘过老房子的门槛。

name: The point of the steel pen was bent and twisted.
trans: 那支钢笔尖被弄弯扭曲了。

name: There is a lag between thought and act.
trans: 思想和行动之间存在滞后。

name: Seed is needed to plant the spring corn.
trans: 种植春玉米需要种子。

name: Draw the chart with heavy black lines.
trans: 用粗黑线画这张图表。

name: The boy owed his pal thirty cents.
trans: 那个男孩欠他伙伴三十美分。

name: The chap slipped into the crowd and was lost.
trans: 那家伙溜进人群中不见了。

name: Hats are worn to tea and not to dinner.
trans: 帽子是喝茶时戴的，晚宴时不戴。

name: The ramp led up to the wide highway.
trans: 那条坡道通向宽阔的公路。

name: Beat the dust from the rug onto the lawn.
trans: 把地毯上的灰尘拍打到草坪上。

name: Say it slowly but make it ring clear.
trans: 慢慢说，但要说得清楚响亮。

name: The straw nest housed five robins.

name: A clean neck means a neat collar.
trans: 干净的脖子意味着整洁的衣领。

trans: 沙发套和门厅的窗帘都是蓝色的。

trans: 那些高脚杯的杯梗裂开又断了。

trans: 挂在墙上的电话响得又大声又频繁。

trans: 那串葡萄被榨成了酒。

trans: 门上的合页因年久而吱吱作响。

trans: 那栋三层楼房是用石头建造的。

trans: 一楼后部有一条宽敞的通道。

trans: 一个穿蓝色毛衣的男人坐在书桌旁。

name: Oats are a food eaten by horse and man.
trans: 燕麦是马和人都吃的食物。

name: Their eyelids droop for want of sleep.
trans: 他们的眼皮因缺觉而耷拉着。

name: A sip of tea revives his tired friend.
trans: 喝一口茶让他疲惫的朋友恢复了精神。

trans: 把床单塞进垫子的边缘下面。

name: A force equal to that would move the earth.
trans: 与之相当的力量足以撼动地球。

name: We like to see clear weather.
trans: 我们喜欢晴朗的天气。

name: The work of the tailor is seen on each side.
trans: 裁缝的手艺从每一侧都能看出来。

name: Take a chance and win a china doll.
trans: 碰碰运气，赢一个瓷娃娃。

trans: 陌生人，把你鞋上的尘土抖掉吧。

name: She was kind to sick old people.
trans: 她对生病的老人很和善。

name: The square wooden crate was packed to be shipped.
trans: 那个方形木箱被打包好准备运走。

name: The dusty bench stood by the stone wall.
trans: 满是灰尘的长凳立在石墙边。

name: We dress to suit the weather of most days.
trans: 我们穿衣服要适应大多数日子的天气。

name: Smile when you say nasty words.
trans: 说难听话的时候也要微笑。

name: A bowl of rice is free with chicken stew.
trans: 点炖鸡送一碗米饭。

name: The water in this well is a source of good health.
trans: 这口井里的水是健康的源泉。

name: Take shelter in this tent, but keep still.
trans: 到这个帐篷里躲一躲，但要保持安静。

name: That guy is the writer of a few banned books.
trans: 那家伙是几本禁书的作者。

name: The little tales they tell are false.
trans: 他们讲的那些小故事都是假的。

name: The door was barred, locked, and bolted as well.
trans: 门不仅上了闩，还锁上了，并且加了插销。

name: Ripe pears are fit for a queen's table.
trans: 熟透的梨适合摆上王后的餐桌。

name: A big wet stain was on the round carpet.
trans: 那块圆形地毯上有一大块湿渍。

name: The kite dipped and swayed, but stayed aloft.
trans: 风筝忽上忽下摇摆，但始终没有掉落。

name: The pleasant hours fly by much too soon.
trans: 愉快的时光过得太快了。

name: The room was crowded with a wild mob.
trans: 房间里挤满了狂乱的人群。

name: This strong arm shall shield your honor.
trans: 这条强壮的手臂将捍卫你的荣誉。

name: She blushed when he gave her a white orchid.
trans: 他送她一朵白兰花时，她脸红了。

name: The beetle droned in the hot June sun.
trans: 甲虫在炎热的六月阳光下嗡嗡作响。

name: Press the pedal with your left foot.
trans: 用左脚踩踏板。

name: Neat plans fail without luck.
trans: 没有运气，再周密的计划也会失败。

name: The black trunk fell from the landing.
trans: 那只黑色的行李箱从楼梯平台上摔了下来。

name: The bank pressed for payment of the debt.
trans: 银行催促偿还债务。

name: The theft of the pearl pin was kept secret.
trans: 珍珠别针失窃一事被保密了。

name: Shake hands with this friendly child.
trans: 和这个友好的孩子握握手。

name: The vast space stretched into the far distance.
trans: 那片浩瀚的空间一直延伸到远方。

name: A rich farm is rare in this sandy waste.
trans: 在这片沙漠荒地上，肥沃的农场很罕见。

name: His wide grin earned many friends.
trans: 他咧嘴一笑赢得了许多朋友。

name: Flax makes a fine brand of paper.
trans: 亚麻能做出上等的纸张。

name: Hurdle the pit with the aid of a long pole.
trans: 借助一根长杆跨过那个坑。

name: A strong bid may scare your partner stiff.
trans: 一个强势的叫牌可能会把你的搭档吓坏。

name: Even a just cause needs power to win.
trans: 即使是正义的事业，也需要力量才能取胜。

name: Peep under the tent and see the clowns.
trans: 从帐篷底下窥视一下小丑们。

name: The leaf drifts along with a slow spin.
trans: 树叶缓缓旋转着随风飘荡。

name: Cheap clothes are flashy but don't last.
trans: 廉价的衣服花哨却不耐穿。

name: A thing of small note can cause despair.
trans: 一件微不足道的小事也能引发绝望。

trans: 那支铅笔两端都削得很尖。

trans: 那最后几句话是一个强有力的声明。

trans: 他在纸的顶端大胆地写下了自己的名字。

name: Dill pickles are sour but taste fine.
trans: 莳萝腌黄瓜虽酸但味道不错。

trans: 沿着那条路走就能到那个种粮农民家。

trans: 最好的方法是用夹子把它固定住。

trans: 如果你含糊不清，讲话就没人能听懂了。

trans: 夜里警报把他从沉睡中惊醒。

name: Read just what the meter says.
trans: 准确读出仪表上显示的数值。

trans: 把你的背包装满给穷人的漂亮小饰品。

trans: 那盏小小的红色霓虹灯熄灭了。

trans: 蛤蜊个头小、圆润、柔软又美味。

trans: 边缘接合处的那条线很整洁。

trans: 一个棕色皮包挂在背带上。

trans: 蟾蜍和青蛙很难分辨。

trans: 白色丝绸夹克配什么鞋都合适。

trans: 大坝的一处决口差点酿成洪灾。

trans: 剑柄上雕刻着精美的图案。

trans: 一个圆孔被钻穿了那块薄木板。

trans: 她在我家前面的草坪上等着。

trans: 边缘附近的一个通风口引入了新鲜空气。

trans: 这是一条三英寸宽的钢带。

trans: 那根管子几乎和沟渠一样长。

trans: 它被一大片树叶和灌木丛遮挡得看不见。

trans: 黄铜管沿着高墙绕了一圈。

trans: 公爵乘坐一辆银色马车离开了公园。

name: Greet the new guests and leave quickly.
trans: 迎接新来的客人，然后迅速离开。

name: A six comes up more often than a ten.
trans: 骰子掷出六点比掷出十点更常见。

trans: 茂盛的蕨类植物长在高耸的岩石上。

trans: 农夫用他的马换了一头棕色的公牛。

trans: 坐在栖木上告诉其他人该做什么。

name: A steep trail is painful for our feet.

name: The early phase of life moves fast.

name: Green moss grows on the northern side.
trans: 绿色的苔藓长在北侧。

name: Tea in thin china has a sweet taste.
trans: 用薄瓷杯泡的茶味道更香甜。

name: The facts don't always show who is right.

name: Plead with the lawyer to drop the lost cause.

name: Calves thrive on tender spring grass.

name: Post no bills on this office wall.
trans: 不许在这面办公室墙上张贴告示。

name: Tear a thin sheet from the yellow pad.
trans: 从黄色便签本上撕下一张薄纸。

name: A cruise in warm waters in a sleek yacht is fun.
trans: 乘着一艘时髦的游艇在温暖的水域巡游很有趣。

name: A streak of color ran down the left edge.
trans: 一道彩色条纹沿左边缘延伸下去。

name: It was done before the boy could see it.
trans: 在那男孩看到之前，这件事就已经完成了。

name: Crouch before you jump or miss the mark.
trans: 起跳前先蹲下，否则会跳不准。

name: Pack the kits and don't forget the salt.
trans: 打包好装备，别忘了盐。

name: The square peg will settle in the round hole.
trans: 方形木钉会卡进圆孔里。

name: Fine soap saves tender skin.
trans: 优质的肥皂能呵护娇嫩的皮肤。

name: Poached eggs and tea must suffice.
trans: 水煮蛋和茶就足够了。

name: Bad nerves are jangled by a door slam.
trans: 摔门声会让紧张的神经更加烦躁。

name: Ship maps are different from those for planes.
trans: 航海图和航空图不一样。

name: Dimes showered down from all sides.
trans: 硬币从四面八方雨点般落下。

name: They sang the same tunes at each party.
trans: 他们在每次聚会上都唱同样的曲子。

name: The sky in the west is tinged with orange red.
trans: 西边的天空染上了橙红色。

name: The pods of peas ferment in bare fields.
trans: 豌豆荚在光秃秃的田野里发酵腐烂。

name: The horse balked and threw the tall rider.
trans: 那匹马突然停步，把高个子骑手甩了下去。

name: The hitch between the horse and cart broke.
trans: 马和车之间的挂钩断了。

name: Pile the coal high in the shed corner.
trans: 把煤堆得高高的，堆在棚子的角落里。

name: A gold vase is both rare and costly.
trans: 一个金花瓶既罕见又昂贵。

name: The knife was hung inside its bright sheath.
trans: 那把刀被挂在它那闪亮的刀鞘里。

name: The rarest spice comes from the far East.
trans: 最稀有的香料来自遥远的东方。

name: The roof should be tilted at a sharp slant.
trans: 屋顶应该以陡峭的角度倾斜。

name: A smatter of French is worse than none.
trans: 一知半解的法语比完全不懂还糟糕。

name: The mule trod the treadmill day and night.
trans: 那头骡子日夜踩着踏车。

name: The aim of the contest is to raise a great fund.
trans: 这场比赛的目的是筹集一大笔资金。

name: To send it now in large amounts is bad.
trans: 现在大量寄送它是不明智的。

name: There is a fine hard tang in salty air.
trans: 咸咸的空气中有一种清冽刺鼻的味道。

name: Cod is the main business of the north shore.
trans: 鳕鱼是北岸的主要产业。

name: The slab was hewn from heavy blocks of slate.
trans: 那块石板是从厚重的板岩块中凿出来的。

name: Dunk the stale biscuits into strong drink.
trans: 把不新鲜的饼干泡进烈酒里。

name: Hang tinsel from both branches.
trans: 在两根树枝上都挂上金属丝彩带。

name: Cap the jar with a tight brass cover.
trans: 用一个紧密的黄铜盖子盖住罐子。

name: The poor boy missed the boat again.
trans: 那个可怜的男孩又错过了船。

name: Be sure to set the lamp firmly in the hole.
trans: 一定要把灯稳稳地安放在那个孔里。

name: Pick a card and slip it under the pack.
trans: 抽一张牌，把它塞到牌堆下面。

name: A round mat will cover the dull spot.
trans: 一块圆垫子能盖住那个暗淡的斑点。

name: The first part of the plan needs changing.
trans: 计划的第一部分需要修改。

name: A good book informs of what we ought to know.
trans: 一本好书能告诉我们该知道的事情。

name: The mail comes in three batches per day.
trans: 邮件每天分三批送到。

name: You cannot brew tea in a cold pot.
trans: 你没法用冷壶泡茶。

name: Dots of light betrayed the black cat.
trans: 点点亮光暴露了那只黑猫的行踪。

name: Put the chart on the mantel and tack it down.
trans: 把图表放在壁炉架上，用图钉固定住。

name: The night shift men rate extra pay.
trans: 上夜班的工人应得额外报酬。

name: The red paper brightened the dim stage.
trans: 红纸让昏暗的舞台亮堂了起来。

name: See the player scoot to third base.
trans: 看那名球员飞奔到三垒。

name: Slide the bill between the two leaves.
trans: 把钞票塞在两页之间。

name: Many hands help get the job done.
trans: 众人拾柴火焰高。

name: We don't like to admit our small faults.
trans: 我们不喜欢承认自己的小错误。

name: No doubt about the way the wind blows.
trans: 风往哪儿吹是毋庸置疑的。

name: Dig deep in the earth for pirate's gold.
trans: 深挖地下寻找海盗的黄金。

name: The steady drip is worse than a drenching rain.
trans: 持续不断的滴水比一场倾盆大雨还烦人。

name: A flat pack takes less luggage space.
trans: 扁平的包装占用较少的行李空间。

name: Green ice frosted the punch bowl.
trans: 绿色的冰块给潘趣酒碗镀上了一层霜。

name: A stuffed chair slipped from the moving van.
trans: 一把软垫椅从搬家的卡车上滑落了。

name: The stitch will serve but needs to be shortened.
trans: 这个针脚可以用，但需要缩短一些。

name: A thin book fits in the side pocket.
trans: 一本薄书能放进侧兜里。

name: The gloss on top made it unfit to read.
trans: 表面的光泽使它无法用来阅读。

name: The hail pattered on the burnt brown grass.
trans: 冰雹噼啪地打在烧焦的棕色草地上。

name: Seven seals were stamped on great sheets.
trans: 七枚印章被盖在大幅纸张上。

name: Our troops are set to strike heavy blows.
trans: 我们的部队准备发起猛烈的攻击。

name: The store was jammed before the sale could start.
trans: 大甩卖还没开始，商店里就挤满了人。

name: It was a bad error on the part of the new judge.
trans: 这是新法官方面犯下的严重错误。

name: One step more and the board will collapse.
trans: 再走一步，木板就会塌陷。

name: Take the match and strike it against your shoe.
trans: 拿起火柴，在你的鞋上划一下。

name: The pot boiled, but the contents failed to jell.
trans: 锅烧开了，但里面的东西没能凝固。

name: The baby puts his right foot in his mouth.
trans: 那个婴儿把他的右脚放进了嘴里。

name: The bombs left most of the town in ruins.
trans: 炸弹使这座城镇大部分沦为废墟。

name: Stop and stare at the hard working man.
trans: 停下来盯着那个辛勤工作的人看。

name: The streets are narrow and full of sharp turns.
trans: 街道狭窄，急转弯很多。

name: The pup jerked the leash as he saw a feline shape.
trans: 那只小狗看到猫的身影时猛地拉扯牵引绳。

name: Open your book to the first page.
trans: 把你的书翻到第一页。

name: Fish evade the net and swim off.
trans: 鱼躲开渔网游走了。

name: Dip the pail once and let it settle.
trans: 把水桶浸一下，让水沉淀下来。

name: Will you please answer that phone.
trans: 你能接一下那个电话吗。

name: The big red apple fell to the ground.
trans: 那个又大又红的苹果掉到了地上。

name: The curtain rose and the show was on.
trans: 帷幕升起，演出开始了。

name: The young prince became heir to the throne.
trans: 那位年轻的王子成为了王位继承人。

name: He sent the boy on a short errand.
trans: 他派那个男孩去办一件小差事。

name: Leave now and you will arrive on time.
trans: 现在就出发，你就能准时到达。

name: The corner store was robbed last night.
trans: 街角的商店昨晚被抢劫了。

name: A gold ring will please most any girl.
trans: 一枚金戒指几乎能取悦任何女孩。

name: The long journey home took a year.
trans: 回家的漫长旅程花了一年时间。

name: She saw a cat in the neighbor's house.
trans: 她看见邻居家有一只猫。

name: A pink shell was found on the sandy beach.
trans: 沙滩上发现了一枚粉红色的贝壳。

name: Small children came to see him.
trans: 小孩子们来看他。

name: The grass and bushes were wet with dew.
trans: 青草和灌木丛被露水打湿了。

name: The blind man counted his old coins.
trans: 那个盲人清点着他的旧硬币。

name: A severe storm tore down the barn.
trans: 一场猛烈的暴风雨摧毁了那座谷仓。

name: She called his name many times.
trans: 她多次呼喊他的名字。

name: When you hear the bell, come quickly.
trans: 听到铃声就快点过来。
